scope: Desktop research: v2.13 and source-verified v2.22; not formal OCR4 acceptance
sourceGameBytes: Unmodified files from the checkout verified against fixed Git blob object IDs.
order: v2.13 then v2.22, repeated; fixed before first start
seed: Natural Math.random, uncontrolled and unknown; no seed selection
freshState: New iframe element with verified expected document URL before every attempt; prior frame removed only after release verification
viewport: Native responsive iframe; no canvas/CSS viewport override; outer/candidate/game/canvas sizes and DPR recorded and fixed per comparison
input: Original game buttons and Arrow/Space events from candidate controller
evidence: Visible native result overlay/title/time or visible game countdown; no hidden game state and no persisted pixels
deadline: When remaining clock is below 02:30 and no native ending animation is running, stop; retain elapsed=300-remaining
settlement: Ending animation stops gameplay; wait up to 5 seconds for visible native result overlay; do not misclassify the controller's normal finish as abort
failurePolicy: Every start retained; no replacement; any abort/unknown prevents confirmation eligibility. Exploration may complete all preplanned attempts if control is safely released.
stop: Click candidate stop, require active=false and zero held keys; if unverified, interrupt batch without replacement
recording: Sequence-checked append-only JSONL fsync. Starts before game click. Fresh-document evidence identity; no prior-attempt HUD used as result. Bounded full numeric planner inputs/outputs; truncation explicitly flagged.
publication: Code and sanitized aggregate status on GitHub; private raw diagnostic data is not public
goalInterpretation: Both versions independently reach at least 6/12 within150s in a fresh complete confirmation cohort; observed sample result, no long-run statistical guarantee
preparation: Before every batch, twelve alternating no-game loads. A standalone preflight never creates batch/start rows. Each preparation verifies candidate HTTP bytes/hash/server instance, attaches load/error listeners and src before insertion, checks real navigation HTTP proof and committed ready document. Exactly one navigation per preparation; no reload/replacement on failure; old 15-second readiness bounds retained.
transport: Source probe is a separate fetch and does not establish subsequent navigation success; actual navigation must independently have matching HTTP 200/source hash, iframe load commit and ready controller/game. Private bounded metadata journal records request/finish/close/server lifecycle; underlying r3 about:blank cause remains unknown.

grow27Geometry.policy: Verify actual geometry; never force viewport, CSS or original game. Other DPR integration unverified.

grow38Geometry.cohort: Default FHD uses a 1920x1080 outer viewport, wide original canvas, DPR1. Optional QHD uses 2560x1440 with original 2250x1308 canvas, DPR1, as a separate frozen geometry contract.
grow38Geometry.originalGameRendering: The parent frame fills the available area. The original game CSS and its bitmap size are not changed. Freeze measured canvas/iframe dimensions before games, and verify identical dimensions on every native start.
grow38Geometry.candidate: Grow24 control and perception bytes; outer desktop layout only.
grow38Geometry.naturalGames: Existing 8 exploration attempts and independent 24 confirmation attempts if eligible. No fixed random seeds.

grow44Geometry.cohort: QHD only: 2560x1440 outer viewport, original 2250x1308 canvas at DPR1; start with --geometry-mode qhd.
grow44Geometry.naturalGames: Same alternating v2.13/v2.22 r4 protocol: 4/edition in exploration, followed by an independent 12/edition confirmation only if each edition wins at least 2/4 within 150 game seconds.
